coaching.headline: A bloody win carried by the objective ledger — 86,648 objective damage to their 13,022, and their six fight wins cashed into exactly nothing.
coaching.team: Three favored reads did their job — Riktor and Kira farmed the offlane and carry matchups while Khaimera won the jungle wire to wire — but the real difference was what each side did after fights: our eight wins bought Mini Prime at 11, Fangtooths at 12 and 17, both Orb Primes and both Primal Fangtooths, while their six fight wins cashed nothing — they took just a 6-minute Fangtooth and a sneak Genesis Core at 25 all game. The mess in the middle was real — the 10.3 and 17.3 losses at our own pits came with the winning offlane still in lane, and the 12.5 loss with the support never joining — but the 11.1 fight, two of us beating four of them 4-0 at our Mini Prime, kept resetting the game our way.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 20.6-to-21.7 double — a 4-0 at our river and then a 3-2 on top of our Orb Prime pit — banked Orb Prime at 22 and Primal Fangtooth at 23, and the 30-minute 4-0 at the Primal pit ended it.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31's Phase healed 24201 — the sustain that let Kira and Khaimera keep re-entering fights — and stood in the two-man 4-0 at our Mini Prime at 11.1, the fight of the game. Six deaths is the tax, and the file also flags him absent from the 9.2 and 12.5 losses; a link support's value is entirely in attendance.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324's Kira won the favored read loudly — 14 kills spread across Zinx, Terra and Serath, with 34126 hero damage — and paid for it with nine deaths. Serath the reset assassin fed on several of those; a Vengeance carry who dies less converts the same damage into shorter games.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Khaimera was the engine underneath everything: a match-high 42,887 objective damage, 7/6/11, the jungle read won all game, and half of the 11.1 two-man 4-0. Three wards is the recurring drill — the 19.8 catch by Serath happens less often on a warded map.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
ourKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
ourKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
ourKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

ourKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
ourKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Wild Rush charge → Ruthless Assault → Highland Hurl slow → Unstoppable Force cleanse ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage Unstoppable and grind with Hersir-empowered swings
enemyKits.passive: Hersir stacks empower the next basic
enemyKits.playAgainst: save CC for after Unstoppable Force; kite her charge

enemyKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
enemyKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 30 minutes, fewer deaths than about 91% of Wraith mid players this patch. The build added health and armor.
Back It Up! at top rank: 95s base, about 53.4s by the end (44% shorter) from 78 ability haste: Prophecy 15, Orion 15, Timewarp 25, Golem's Gift 15, Typhoon 8.
Timewarp (Chime): Every 8s: Subtract 1s from Non-Ultimate Cooldowns.
Wraith dealt 33,213 hero damage, 24% of their team's, with +0 physical power from items.
Prophecy (item): On Basic Attacks: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage On-Hit.
Orion (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Deal 2% increased damage to the Target for 3.5s, up to a maximum of 16%.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Toughness: +100 health, +40 physical armor; took 16,680 damage, mitigated 8,760, died 1 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Prophecy, Orion, Typhoon.
Countered? 0 of the 2 players Wraith killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on Terra, Serath. We killed Wraith 1 time.
Copy it? Too few Wraith midlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

card.lesson: Back It Up! came back about every 53s instead of 95s by the end (44% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 992 hero damage a minute, more than 84% of Khaimera jungle players this patch (21% of the team's). The damage came from Manta Scythe, Sky Splitter, Draconum.
Cull at top rank: 60s base, about 52.2s by the end (13% shorter) from 15 ability haste: Draconum 15.
18 takedowns (7 kills, 11 assists) fed: Draconum (Flow).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Khaimera dealt 29,747 hero damage, 21% of their team's, with +122 physical power from items.

Penetration: Manta Scythe 10; against Serath (level 17 estimated: about 110 physical armor, 100 after penetration) and Grux (level 17 estimated: about 124 physical armor, 114 after penetration) that is about 5% and 5% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Manta Scythe (item): Against Enemy Units within 2500u: If they have no Ally within 1000u of themselves, deal 8% more damage to them.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Draconum (item): On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.
Judgement (crest): Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.

Sustain: 14% lifesteal; 4% omnivamp; Draconum: On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.; Draconum: On Takedown: Restore (+120%)(+6%) Health.; Judgement: Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.; 12,985 healing recorded.
Toughness: +100 health, +40 physical armor; took 55,900 damage, mitigated 35,266, died 6 times.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 4 effects on one trigger: Manta Scythe, Sky Splitter, Draconum, Judgement.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Manta Scythe, Sky Splitter.
Countered? 0 of the 4 players Khaimera killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on Terra, Serath. We killed Khaimera 6 times.
Copy it? Too few Khaimera jungle games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.
